title: Sleepy turtle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shell -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='21' fill='#3aa655'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#57c96e'/>
  <!-- shell pattern -->
  <path d='M50 44 L58 56 L50 68 L42 56 Z' fill='#2f8a45'/>
  <path d='M26 58 L36 52 L38 64 L28 68 Z' fill='#2f8a45'/>
  <path d='M74 58 L64 52 L62 64 L72 68 Z' fill='#2f8a45'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#8fe89e'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='80' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#4fae3f'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='80' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#4fae3f'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='54' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#6cc24a'/>
  <!-- sleepy eyes: closed curved lines -->
  <path d='M77 51 Q80 54 83 51' fill='none' stroke='#253a1a' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M85 51 Q88 54 91 51' fill='none' stroke='#253a1a' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='58' r='2.2' fill='#f5a3b0'/>
  <circle cx='89' cy='58' r='2.2' fill='#f5a3b0'/>
  <!-- small smile -->
  <path d='M81 60 Q84 63 87 60' fill='none' stroke='#253a1a' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M88 36 L93 36 L88 41 L93 41' fill='none' stroke='#9be7ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M78 28 L82 28 L78 32 L82 32' fill='none' stroke='#9be7ff' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
